purpose: Continue broad P0 scanning while subtracting already-organized exchanges. Promote only low-permission, low-capital hypotheses that can be falsified through direct actor truth before product build.

actors: international students in Xuzhou who retain first-hand home-country language, consumer, communication and everyday market context
Xuzhou SMEs / OPCs considering Southeast Asia or other overseas markets before committing to heavier consulting, travel, exhibition or local entity setup
new_probe_candidate.observed_gradient: local international students possess home-country cultural and communication context that is usually used socially/academically rather than as a bounded market-sense resource, while small exporting actors can face low-level pre-market uncertainties that are too small for a formal consulting engagement but costly if repeatedly guessed wrong
public_support: Xuzhou University of Technology reports about 250 international students and continues English-taught international business/e-commerce-related programs in 2026.

China University of Mining and Technology reported more than 300 new international students participating in September 2026 legal/safety orientation, confirming a substantial locally reachable international-student population.

A 2026 Shanghai university field-practice case documents Thai international students supporting Chinese exhibitors in Thailand by resolving language, cultural and local-market-rule misunderstandings, proving this type of contextual resource can be practically useful.

Xuzhou manufacturing actors are actively expanding into Southeast Asia, while Jiangsu is simultaneously building a large formal overseas-service system for legal, tax, finance, market and landing support.
existing_exchange_to_subtract: chambers of commerce and CCPIT programs
new_probe_candidate.narrow_missing_edge_question: Before a small exporter buys formal consulting or commits to travel/market entry, is there a repeated class of 15-30 minute factual market-context checks (wording naturalness, channel reality, first-contact norms, consumer interpretation, obvious local-assumption errors) that current formal providers are too heavy for, and that a home-country student can answer lawfully and reliably without pretending to be a professional consultant?
why_p0_accessible: student-side truth is reachable through public university international-education gateways
buyer-side truth is reachable through public trade/chamber gateways
first probe requires interviews only, no proprietary enterprise systems or capital
no pairing or paid work is needed to falsify the hypothesis
the commercial/legal boundary can be tested before any execution

legal_gate.rule: International students holding study residence permits may not perform off-campus work-study/internship without school approval and residence-permit annotation for the relevant unit/location/period.
legal_gate.p0_implication: Current phase is voluntary research interviews only. No paid task, placement or commercial delivery may be arranged unless the school confirms a lawful mechanism and required immigration annotations are completed.

first_probe.student_side: Ask 5 international students, through institutional forwarding where possible, for recent examples where local context changed the interpretation of an otherwise correct translation; capture what they can answer reliably, what they refuse, and whether current university practice already organizes this resource.
first_probe.enterprise_side: Ask 5 SMEs/OPCs with recent overseas-market activity for their most recent small market-context uncertainty, current workaround, whether formal service providers already solve it cheaply, and whether a bounded factual check would change a real decision.
first_probe.no_pairing_before: repeated same-shaped uncertainty appears on the enterprise side and repeated bounded callable context appears on the student side

promotion_gate: >=3/5 enterprise actors report the same category of low-level pre-market uncertainty after considering current formal routes
>=3/5 student actors can demonstrate first-hand bounded context relevant to that category and define refusal/uncertainty boundaries
at least one lawful participation structure is confirmed by an institution before any compensated work
the contribution has objective acceptance criteria and is not merely generic translation
at least one enterprise actor makes a real economic or reciprocal commitment only after the legal gate is clear
kill_conditions: formal export/translation services already solve the same micro-check cheaply and quickly
student answers are anecdotal, unverifiable or too inconsistent for decision use
the model depends on unpaid or underpaid international-student labor
school/immigration rules make the intended participation shape impractical
no enterprise actor changes a real decision or makes a commitment

new_outreach_events.organization: 徐州工程学院国际教育学院
new_outreach_events.request: forward a voluntary anonymous 15-minute research probe to a small number of international students; explicitly not recruitment, paid work or commercial delivery

new_outreach_events.organization: 徐州市国际商会 / 徐州市贸促会 public trade gateway
new_outreach_events.request: help identify or forward to 3-5 Xuzhou firms considering Southeast Asia so the study can capture recent small market-context uncertainties and whether existing services already solve them

closure_scan.signal: traditional wholesale-market merchants lack new-media operating skill
public_evidence: Xuzhou agricultural wholesale market publicly reports long-term offline dependence and weak new-media operating skills among merchants.
The market already provides official traffic, routine livestreaming and practical livestream/short-video training to more than one hundred merchants.
Commercial Douyin/e-commerce operation agencies and official Douyin service-provider routes are already widely available.
closure_scan.reopen_only_if: direct merchants show a repeated post-training and post-agency failure mode that is specifically below agency economics or caused by a distinct coordination/acceptance edge

closure_scan.public_evidence: Xuzhou industrial parks are already actively repurposing low-efficiency land and factories, while public reporting identifies debt, title and legacy liabilities as core blockers.
Jiangsu and Xuzhou already operate or are building extensive overseas-service, platform, association, legal, tax, finance, exhibition and matching infrastructure.
